readings.Aries: What you call impatience is actually high sensitivity to wasted potential. Channel it. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Taurus: Someone is waiting for you to say what you mean. The long way around is costing you both. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Gemini: Your pattern recognition is excellent. The pattern you're missing is the one closest to you. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Cancer: Your sensitivity is precision, not weakness. The readings it gives are accurate. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Leo: The drama unfolding around you is partly your own creation. What would quiet look like? Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Virgo: The research phase of this decision is complete. The decision phase requires something research can't provide. Trust the slow version of this over the fast one.
readings.Libra: The version of events you're working to make fair was never quite fair to you. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Scorpio: Something you decided a long time ago is governing today. It may not still be correct. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Sagittarius: There is a person who has expanded your worldview more than you've acknowledged. Acknowledge it. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Capricorn: The thing you are in service of — your family, your work, your future self — check that it still deserves the service. The first instinct was right.
readings.Aquarius: There is someone who would surprise you if you let them. You haven't let them. Let them. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Pisces: The sacrifice you made was real and it was meaningful and it is done. You don't have to keep paying. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
